As per the latest update, the payment was processed on 17 September.

Please note that security deposit refunds are released between Monday and Thursday, following the required management approval process. Based on this timeline, you should receive the refund next week between Monday and Thursday.

We sincerely apologize for the delay and assure you that we are following up with the Finance Team. The remaining processing time is subject to the management approval process, which is beyond our direct control.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.
